name: O365_Success Login Outside Brazil
xql_query:
// ============================================================
// Rule: O365_Success Login Outside Brazil
// Vendor: Microsoft 365
// Objective:
// Detect activity associated with O365_Success Login Outside Brazil.
// Severity: SEV_030_MEDIUM
// Category: CREDENTIAL_ACCESS
// ============================================================
// SANITIZED: Environment-specific values replaced with generic placeholders.
// MITRE ATT&CK:
// Tactic: TA0001 - Initial Access
// Technique: T1078 - Valid Accounts

dataset = msft_azure_raw
| filter operationName = "Sign-in activity" and category = "SignInLogs"
| alter result_code = to_integer(resultType),
        result_desc = resultDescription,
        user_dst = properties -> userPrincipalName,
        appDisplayName = properties -> appDisplayName,
        userDisplayName = properties -> userDisplayName,
        userAgent = properties -> userAgent,
        authenticationRequirement = properties ->  authenticationRequirement,
        isInteractive = properties -> isInteractive,
        OS = json_extract_scalar(properties, "$.deviceDetail.operatingSystem"),
        result = trim(arrayindex(regextract(properties, "result\":\"([^,]+)"), 0), "\""),
        City = json_extract_scalar(properties, "$.location.city"),
        State = json_extract_scalar(properties, "$.location.state"),
        Country = json_extract_scalar(properties, "$.location.countryOrRegion")


// Altera as configurações de Multiplo Fator na autenticação
| alter authenticationRequirement = if(authenticationRequirement = "multiFactorAuthentication", "Autenticacao Multifatorial", "Autenticacao de Fator Unico")

//Outside Brazil Filter
| filter (Country not in (null, """""")) 
| filter Country != "BR" and resultSignature = "SUCCESS" and isInteractive = "True" and appDisplayName != "Microsoft Azure Active Directory Connect"

//EXCEPTIONS

//APP Exceptions

| filter (appDisplayName not in ("<INTERNAL_APPLICATION_1>", "<INTERNAL_APPLICATION_2>", "<INTERNAL_APPLICATION_6>", "JDBC Client Driver", "Microsoft Power BI", "Windows Sign In")) 

//User Exceptions

| filter (`user_dst` not in ("<USER_EMAIL_1>", 
"<USER_EMAIL_2>",
"<USER_EMAIL_3>",
"<USER_EMAIL_4>",
"<USER_EMAIL_5>",
"<USER_EMAIL_2>",
"<USER_EMAIL_6>",
"<USER_EMAIL_7>",
"<USER_EMAIL_8>",
"<USER_EMAIL_9>",
"<USER_EMAIL_10>",
"<USER_EMAIL_11>",
"<USER_EMAIL_12>",
"<USER_EMAIL_12>",
"<USER_EMAIL_13>",
"<USER_EMAIL_14>",
"<USER_EMAIL_15>",
"<USER_EMAIL_16>",
"<USER_EMAIL_17>",
"<USER_EMAIL_1>",
"<USER_EMAIL_18>",
"<USER_EMAIL_19>",
"<USER_EMAIL_20>",
"<USER_EMAIL_7>",
"<USER_EMAIL_21>",
"<USER_EMAIL_22>",
"<USER_EMAIL_23>",
"<USER_EMAIL_24>",
"<USER_EMAIL_25>",
"<USER_EMAIL_26>",
"<USER_EMAIL_27>")) 

| filter user_dst contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_20>"
    or user_dst contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_10>"
    or user_dst contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_7>"
    or user_dst contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_11>"
    or user_dst contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_18>"
    or user_dst contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_16>"
    or user_dst contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_4>"
    or user_dst contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_26>"
    or user_dst contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_12>"
    or user_dst contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_17>"
    or user_dst contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_5>"
    or user_dst contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_13>"
    or user_dst contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_2>"
    or user_dst contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_14>"
    or user_dst contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_3>"
    or user_dst contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_1>"
    or user_dst contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_21>"
    or user_dst contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_27>"
    or user_dst contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_19>"
    or user_dst contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_28>"
    or user_dst contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_9>"
    or user_dst contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_22>"
    or user_dst contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_15>"
    or user_dst contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_23>"
    or user_dst contains "<INTERNAL_DOMAIN_6>"

| fields userDisplayName, user_dst, Country, appDisplayName, useragent, city, state, authenticationRequirement, callerIpAddress
description: Este alerta indica que foi realizada com sucesso uma tentativa de login em uma conta do Office 365 a partir de uma localização geográfica fora do Brasil. Embora o acesso possa ser legítimo, ele pode também representar risco de comprometimento de credenciais, especialmente se não houver justificativa para acessos internacionais. Recomenda-se verificar o usuário envolvido, o endereço IP de origem, o país do login e se há histórico recente de logins similares. Caso o acesso não seja reconhecido, medidas como redefinição de senha e verificação de MFA devem ser consideradas.
alert_description: O usuário $userDisplayName ( $user_dst ) acessou o aplicativo $appDisplayName com sucesso a partir de $city / $state – $Country , com IP $callerIpAddress e requisito de autenticação $authenticationRequirement .
